items.title: Daybreak for Frontline Defenders: $1B to protect essential services
items.content: OpenAI introduces Daybreak for Frontline Defenders. A $1 billion commitment expands access to frontier cyber AI, training, and support for essential services.
items.contentSnippet: OpenAI introduces Daybreak for Frontline Defenders. A $1 billion commitment expands access to frontier cyber AI, training, and support for essential services.

summaries.zh: OpenAI推出“Daybreak for Frontline Defenders”计划，承诺投入10亿美元，扩大前沿网络安全AI、培训及支持服务的获取范围，以保护关键基础设施和基本服务。该计划旨在帮助一线防御者应对网络威胁，提升整体安全韧性。
summaries.en: OpenAI has announced the "Daybreak for Frontline Defenders" initiative, a $1 billion commitment aimed at strengthening cybersecurity for essential services. The program will expand access to frontier cyber AI tools, along with training and support. Its goal is to help protect critical infrastructure and frontline organizations from evolving digital threats. The announcement underscores a focused investment in safeguarding services that are vital to daily operations.

items.summary: OpenAI推出“Daybreak for Frontline Defenders”计划，承诺投入10亿美元，扩大前沿网络安全AI、培训及支持服务的获取范围，以保护关键基础设施和基本服务。该计划旨在帮助一线防御者应对网络威胁，提升整体安全韧性。

items.title: Playco cut manual fixes 50% prototyping games with GPT-6 Astra
items.content: Using GPT-6 Astra, Playco built three themed game prototypes from one grey box foundation and reported 50% fewer manual fixes than with the previous model.

summaries.en: Playco used GPT-6 Astra to create three themed game prototypes from a single grey box foundation. According to the report, this approach led to 50% fewer manual fixes compared to their previous model. summaries.en: Legora used GPT-6 Astra to complete a financial-review task, processing 41 documents in minutes. The AI tool successfully identified all four deliberately planted errors and contributed to a performance improvement of nearly 40% in the workflow.

items.title: ATV Big Air Tour turned 3 days of work into 3 hours with ChatGPT
items.content: ATV Big Air Tour uses ChatGPT Work to speed up marketing, merchandising, and more. It even turned merchandise photos into an inventory website in 15 minutes.
items.contentSnippet: ATV Big Air Tour uses ChatGPT Work to speed up marketing, merchandising, and more. It even turned merchandise photos into an inventory website in 15 minutes.

summaries.zh: ATV Big Air Tour 利用 ChatGPT Work 加速其营销和商品管理等工作流程，将原本需要 3 天完成的任务缩短至 3 小时。此外，该团队还借助此工具，在 15 分钟内将商品照片转化为一个库存网站。这体现了 AI 工具在提升运营效率方面的实际应用。
summaries.en: ATV Big Air Tour uses ChatGPT Work to significantly speed up its business operations. The company reports that tasks which previously took three days can now be completed in just three hours. ChatGPT is used to accelerate marketing and merchandising efforts. For example, merchandise photos were turned into a functional inventory website in only 15 minutes. This demonstrates how the company leverages the AI tool to streamline workflows and improve efficiency across multiple parts of its operations.

items.content: ChatGPT can now connect to trusted healthcare data, helping clinicians securely access patient context, medical research, and more.
items.contentSnippet: ChatGPT can now connect to trusted healthcare data, helping clinicians securely access patient context, medical research, and more.

summaries.zh: 医疗机构现可将电子健康档案（EHR）及其他行业数据接入ChatGPT。通过连接可信的医疗数据，ChatGPT能够帮助临床医生安全地获取患者背景信息、医学研究资料等，从而提升诊疗效率与决策支持。
summaries.en: Healthcare organizations can now integrate electronic health records (EHR) and other industry data with ChatGPT. This new capability allows the AI tool to connect to trusted healthcare information, enabling clinicians to securely access relevant patient context, medical research, and additional resources. The integration is designed to help streamline clinical workflows by providing secure, convenient access to critical data.

items.title: Our decision on Cursor following its acquisition by SpaceX
items.content: Our decision to wind down our contract providing OpenAI models to Cursor following its acquisition by SpaceX.

summaries.zh: 在 Cursor 被 SpaceX 收购后，我们决定逐步终止向其提供 OpenAI 模型的合同。这意味着双方现有合作将结束，Cursor 将不再继续使用 OpenAI 模型。该决定是基于收购事项做出的调整。
summaries.en: The company announced it will wind down its contract supplying OpenAI models to Cursor, a decision made in response to Cursor’s acquisition by SpaceX. The announcement focuses on proactive measures to prevent similar issues and strengthen overall resilience in AI development and deployment.

items.title: Stampli cuts launch hours by 68% using ChatGPT Work
items.content: With a fixed deadline and design resources committed elsewhere, Stampli used Codex and ChatGPT Work to compress weeks of launch production into days.
items.contentSnippet: With a fixed deadline and design resources committed elsewhere, Stampli used Codex and ChatGPT Work to compress weeks of launch production into days.

summaries.zh: Stampli 在面临固定截止日期且设计资源已被占用的情况下，借助 Codex 和 ChatGPT Work，将原本需要数周的发布筹备工作压缩至数天完成。此举显著加快了从创意到产品上市的进程，展示了 AI 工具在提升项目效率、缩短交付周期方面的实际价值。文章重点突出了 AI 辅助工具如何帮助团队突破资源限制，快速实现目标。
summaries.en: Stampli leveraged ChatGPT Work and Codex to accelerate product launches under a tight deadline. With design resources already assigned elsewhere, the team used these AI tools to compress what would typically take weeks of launch production into just days. This enabled faster movement from idea to market while working around limited internal capacity. The case highlights how AI-assisted workflows can streamline production processes and help teams meet fixed timelines efficiently.

items.title: Offering Zero Data Retention for frontier models
items.content: OpenAI reaffirms Zero Data Retention for eligible API customers and previews Private Safety Processing for advanced AI safety without compromising data privacy.
items.contentSnippet: OpenAI reaffirms Zero Data Retention for eligible API customers and previews Private Safety Processing for advanced AI safety without compromising data privacy.

summaries.zh: OpenAI重申，符合条件的API客户仍可享受零数据保留（ZDR）政策，并预览了“私人安全处理”功能。该功能旨在为前沿模型提供高级AI安全保护，同时不损害数据隐私。这意味着客户数据用于安全审查时不会被存储，兼顾了安全需求与隐私保障。
summaries.en: OpenAI has reaffirmed its commitment to Zero Data Retention (ZDR) for eligible API customers using frontier models. The company also previewed a new capability called Private Safety Processing, designed to enable advanced AI safety measures without compromising data privacy. This initiative underscores OpenAI’s efforts to maintain strict data-handling standards while advancing safety protocols. The announcement highlights both the continuation of existing privacy protections and the introduction of new methods to balance robust safety with user confidentiality.

items.summary: OpenAI重申，符合条件的API客户仍可享受零数据保留（ZDR）政策，并预览了“私人安全处理”功能。该功能旨在为前沿模型提供高级AI安全保护，同时不损害数据隐私。这意味着客户数据用于安全审查时不会被存储，兼顾了安全需求与隐私保障。

items.title: Replit expands access to software creation with GPT-5.6 Luna
items.content: Replit introduces Free Mode, powered by GPT-5.6 Luna, so anyone can turn ideas into working software without worrying about token costs.
items.contentSnippet: Replit introduces Free Mode, powered by GPT-5.6 Luna, so anyone can turn ideas into working software without worrying about token costs.

summaries.zh: Replit推出全新免费模式（Free Mode），由GPT-5.6 Luna驱动，让任何人都能将自己的想法转化为可运行的软件，无需担心令牌（token）费用。这一举措降低了软件开发的门槛，使用户无需付费即可体验AI辅助编程。总结来说，Replit旨在通过免费模式普及软件创建能力，以GPT-5.6 Luna为技术核心，让创意实现更简单、更便捷。
summaries.en: Replit has expanded access to software creation by introducing Free Mode, powered by GPT-5.6 Luna. This new offering allows anyone to turn ideas into working software without worrying about token costs. The feature lowers barriers for users, making it easier to build and experiment with software directly on the platform.
